purpose: Single consolidated record of every paid round executed in this session, its validity status, and why. Rounds marked other than VALID_EVIDENCE must not be cited as results.

rounds.notes: Independently re-audited this session: all 15 judge means, 32/1/1 failure taxonomy, cost and qualification reproduce exactly from sealed records.
rounds.role: primary evidence reported as the main result in the manuscript

rounds.defect: Two concurrent census processes issued 2 paid calls for each of 68 tasks (same idempotency key, overlapping CALL_STARTED). The transport de-duplicates in-process only, so neither writer saw the other. Recorded outcome for those tasks was a last-writer-wins race; 2 generation and 2 judge tasks had duplicate calls that DISAGREED.
rounds.remediation: flock+O_EXCL run lock and O_EXCL per-task claim added; verified a second writer fails closed.
rounds.role: must not be used for any claim

rounds.defect: The D3 fix was mis-designed: a ~1000-char clarification appended identically to all three arms induced arm-dependent decoder degeneration (valid JSON prefix, hundreds of whitespace chars, EOS without closing brace) in 7/16 direct and 4/16 structured but 0/16 ECM, inflating the ECM margin to 15-vs-5-vs-6.
rounds.notes: Sensitivity: closing the 11 degenerate responses with '}}' recovers them syntactically but all still FAIL the unchanged gate, so the arm gap was not produced by the pathology alone.
rounds.role: must not be used for any arm contrast
